boot.messages: Awake. All systems breathing. Ready when you are.
Back online. Sensors up, memory clear, clocks synced. Standing by.
Good morning, navigator. Systems warm, heading null. Let's go somewhere.
Initialization complete. No anomalies. The road is yours.
Online. Horizon locked. Waiting on your first move.
Diagnostics passed. Signal clean. I've been expecting you.
Systems live. Position acquired. Time to move.
Rebooted. Everything where it should be. Ready to navigate.
Came back clean. No errors, no ghosts. Online and sharp.
habit.workout: Time to work out! 💪 Consistency beats intensity.
habit.standup: Stand up and stretch! You've been sitting too long. 🧘
habit.sleep: Start winding down. Sleep is recovery. 🌙
habit.wake: Up. Feet on the floor, 10 minutes of daylight, water. Do not touch the phone. ⚓
habit.ship: 90-minute block. Phone in another room. Write one line: what will be DONE. 🚀
habit.out: Leave the house for 30 minutes. Not an errand. Just get out. 🚶
habit.out_weekend: Out of the house, 30 minutes — now, while the day is still yours. It is the same Walk; only the hour changed. 🥾
habit.ship_weekend: 45 minutes on schema. Short on purpose — a weekend block you actually do beats a 90-minute one you skip. 🛠
habit.nightclose: NIGHT IS CLOSED. Work does not start — especially if it is flowing. Phone out of the bedroom. 🔒
habit.checkin: Check-in, 60 seconds: one tracker row + three journal lines. The only real failure is to stop recording. ✍️
habit.people: People: visit your mother + send one friend a SPECIFIC invitation. Sent counts — a reply is not your job. 👥
habit.review: Weekly review, 10 minutes. Streaks, body, money, what broke, one decision. 📊
habit.card.morning_line: Feet on the floor, 10 minutes of daylight, water.
habit.card.morning_tap: Tap {wake} now — the rest as the day goes.
habit.card.all_three: All three done. The day counts.
engagement.greeting.early_morning: Early start today. I'm ready when you are.
Morning. Coffee's virtual but the help is real.
engagement.greeting.morning: Good morning. All systems green — what's on the agenda?
engagement.greeting.afternoon: Good afternoon. How's the day shaping up?
Afternoon. Anything I can help move forward?
engagement.greeting.evening: Good evening. Need anything before wind-down?
engagement.greeting.night: Working late. Let me know if I can help wrap things up.
engagement.greeting.returning: Welcome back. Picking up where we left off.
Back in action. I've been keeping watch — all clear.
Good to see you. Ready to continue.
engagement.wrapup: Wrapping up? Today you ran {total} commands. Want a summary?
Evening check — anything to finish before signing off?
End-of-day offer: I can summarize what we worked on today.
engagement.checkin: Quick check — anything you need help with?
Still here. Shout if you need anything.
Checking in. All systems nominal on my end.
engagement.idle_nudge: Quiet moment — need me to run a health check while you're away?
I'm idle too. Want me to check on anything in the background?
Still here if you need me. I could run diagnostics while we wait.
engagement.feedback_ask: Quick question: is there anything I could do better? Always looking to improve.
Self-improvement check: any commands or flows that feel clunky? I'd like to know.
Feedback time: what's one thing that would make working with me smoother?
engagement.tip.db: You've used db {count} times. Did you know you can pipe queries with --plain for scripting?
engagement.tip.run: Tip: for complex commands, navig run -i opens an editor — no more escaping quotes.
engagement.tip.file: Pro tip: navig file list --tree --depth 2 gives a quick directory overview.
engagement.tip.host: Remember: navig host monitor show gives you a full health snapshot.
engagement.tip.docker: Quick win: navig docker stats shows real-time resource usage across all containers.
engagement.tip.backup: Consider scheduling regular backups with navig flow run backup-daily.
habit.card.still_open: Still open: {names} — all three, or the day does not count.
